text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pushing past their limits together in a 
phenomenal race, Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno 
Muteki sent the crowd into a roaring 
frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having witnessed their race, Sakura 
Chiyono O firmly vows to push past her own 
limits and catch up to Mejiro Ardan and 
the others without fail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki stated that if she was to 
face Sakura Chiyono O as well, the next 
stage would be the Takarazuka Kinen, and 
declared she would be the victor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling blessed to have Yaeno Muteki as 
her rival, Mejiro Ardan sets her sights on 
their promised stage, the Takarazuka 
Kinen.
